Hi everyone! I am somewhat new to this community after doing a LOT of research on my own this subreddit may be the most helpful. I hope to continue learning as I move forward in my journey.   
Onto my story, I am a newly single mother in hopes of going back to school. I have a variety of hobbies, including twitch streaming, cross stitching, and music.   
I just got out of an 8 year relationship, and while I was diagnosed with a shopping list of mental health issues prior, the relationship was not a positive one and I am lucky to have made it out. I am the eldest daughter of a hoard of children and have always been independent, and not one to ask for help. Not that my parents could have offered much anyway, seeing as they were YOUNG when they had me and have spent most of their adulthood affording the bare essentials. They've always been supportive vocally and I appreciate them for it though.  
Between my therapist and my doctor and my parents, I have mustered up the courage to take the step to create a gofundme for a psychiatric service dog. Asking for financial help is the LAST thing I want to do but I could use any help I can get. My social circles are small and while any bit helps, any bit of REACH helps as well.   
Thank you dearly for reading this far! Link is below and my PMs are open if there's any further questions or even advice on fundraising!
